title: Discovering Your Primary Love Language
coreMove: Find the primary language by tracing pain, repeated requests, giving habits, memories, elimination, and tank checks before treating any label as settled.

exampleSpecs.audience: Malcolm, a spouse tracing the hurt behind a complaint
exampleSpecs.stakes: A complaint about tone may reveal the primary language that drains fastest.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use judgmental words as a diagnostic clue rather than a generic conflict.

exampleSpecs.audience: Kabir, a spouse hearing a repeated request differently
exampleSpecs.stakes: A pattern dismissed as nagging may be a request for love in action.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Connect help around the house to Acts of Service without moralizing.

exampleSpecs.audience: Ludivine, a spouse using a structured tool carefully
exampleSpecs.stakes: A near-tie on a profile could become a rigid identity or a useful hypothesis.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use 5lovelanguages.com as a supplement to lived patterns.

exampleSpecs.audience: Preston, a spouse turning vague distance into a measurable exchange
exampleSpecs.stakes: Without a number and one request, dissatisfaction stays too foggy to learn from.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the Love Tank Check game with rating, action, and repeated rhythm.

exampleSpecs.audience: Daniel, a spouse looking backward for emotional clues
exampleSpecs.stakes: Early memories can reveal which form of love first filled the tank.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use memory and ideal-spouse clues to identify a primary language.

exampleSpecs.audience: Noel, a spouse sorting close love-language scores
exampleSpecs.stakes: When every language sounds important, elimination can reveal priority without stereotyping.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use process of elimination and avoid assuming Physical Touch from gender.
